# truenas_dataset (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS dataset by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full dataset path, e.g. tank/mydata.

### Read-Only

- `acltype` (String)
- `comments` (String)
- `compression` (String)
- `encrypted` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mountpoint` (String)
- `pool` (String)
- `quota` (Number)
- `refquota` (Number)
- `reservation` (Number)
- `share_type` (String)
- `special_small_block_size` (String) Special allocation class small-block threshold in bytes, as a decimal string. INHERIT when the property is not set on this dataset itself (inherited, default or received), and null when the dataset's type does not carry the property.
- `type` (String)
- `volsize` (Number)
